title: "Don't turn off the TV"
blurb: Negation: a keyword matcher sees 'turn off the TV' and kills the match. The decider hears the 'don't'.

steps.text: Alex is watching the match. Sam walks past and reaches for the remote.
Don't turn off the TV, I'm still watching.
A keyword matcher sees 'turn off the TV' and kills the match. The decider heard the 'don't': no action (2B 65%, 12B 60%).
